summary.text: Norlin Mommsen is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 70 who has served in the Iowa House since 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as farmer.

paragraphs.text: Norlin Mommsen was born in Clinton, Iowa, and graduated from East Central High School in Miles, Iowa.
His career experience includes working as a farmer, and he has served on the board of directors of the Clinton County Farm Bureau and on the Clinton County 4-H Youth Board.
Mommsen first took office in the Iowa House in 2015 and previously ran in District 97 before the 2022 redistricting, winning that seat in 2020 over Ryan Zeskey.
In District 70 he defeated Kay Pence in the general elections of 2022 and 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him assigned to the House Agriculture, House Appropriations, House Transportation and Natural Resources committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat George Pickup in the general election.
